title: Canonical coefficient pullback agrees with termwise localization
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $R,S$ commutative ring sheaves on their small pro-etale sites, and $c:f^{-1}R\simeq S$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $C,I$ be ordinary module pullback with coefficients $c$ and the identity of $f^{-1}R$, let $U$ be scalar restriction along $c$, and let $Q$ denote localization of cochain complexes. Let $b:DC;DU\simeq DI$ be the canonical exact-derived restriction/pullback comparison with base identity restriction removed [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. Let $\beta:C_{\rm Ch};U_{\rm Ch}\simeq I_{\rm Ch}$ be the termwise ordinary comparison with the same base identity removed. Write $\epsilon_C:Q;DC\simeq C_{\rm Ch};Q$, and analogously for $I,U$, for the specified exact-derived factorization isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Then for every complex $P$, $b_{QP};\epsilon_I(P)=DU(\epsilon_C(P));\epsilon_U(C_{\rm Ch}P);Q(\beta_P)$. No flatness or boundedness is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the identity normalization mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_factorsh on the image of P in the homotopy category; the quotient comparison maps and all identity maps cancel. Combining this with mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac for the identity ordinary restriction gives its factorization.

Expand b into inverse exact-composition comparison, localized ordinary restriction mate and exact-composition comparison. Apply mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac on each side and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac to the mate. Cancel inverse isomorphisms. The remaining localized termwise map is beta; its component is the ordinary mate component with identity composites removed.

theorem pullback_factors {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (P : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ) :
    (pullback f R S c).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors f R
          ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R)
          (Iso.refl _)).hom.app P =
      (pbcDerivedRestrict c.hom).map
          ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors f R S c).hom.app P) ≫
        (pbcRestrict c.hom).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((CoefficientTensorChain.complexPullback f R S c).hom.app P)
